name: 節目を追う案件一覧
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0071 three-project milestone/health list, ONLY this component.
Original images1/2 PRIMARY for exact icon anatomy/stroke/optical weight, proportions, artwork, distinct metadata/states and fine details. Mock image3 SECONDARY Japanese copy; its identical list glyphs, green half-circles, mint avatars and gray bars for every row are wrong.
Wide compact logical1188x180 WHITE table/canvas, no outer card. Header six text labels「名称」「健全性」「優先度」「責任者」「目標日」「状態」, original broad first53% column, health53.4%, priority70%, lead78.2%, target85.5%, status97%. Right header label fully visible from component mapping, no side-panel occlusion.
EXACTLY3 rows:
1 original gray DOCUMENT artwork,「利用者の声と行動の集計…」; original AMBER hollow diamond +「目的の共有…」(visible truncated prefix ONLY, hidden full milestone unknown); health original small pale-green circle/green rising zigzag; priority ORANGE rounded-square/WHITE!; lead PURPLE AM avatar; date「4月15日」; status original AMBER thin HEXAGON outline with inner circular/wedge mark.
2 original thin HEADPHONE glyph,「利用者体験の調査支援」; original amber diamond + known full milestone「目的の共有と整理」; health original EMPTY GRAY DASHED CIRCLE; priority original three ascending gray bars; lead purple AM avatar; date「4月24日」; same amber hex/wedge status.
3 original BLUE-PURPLE HEART with WHITE PULSE artwork,「初回利用の改善」; milestone EMPTY (no diamond or text); health empty gray dashed circle; priority three ascending gray bars; lead original UNASSIGNED DASHED PERSON placeholder (no minted initials or invented person); target date EMPTY; status original EMPTY ORANGE DOTTED HEXAGON. Do not copy row1/2 metadata into empty cells.
Preserve exact original artwork/icon silhouettes, optical sizes/baselines and row heights. Body/header Meiryo Regular14/24 tracking0, no bold text/new title. Pure-white surfaces, quiet neutral rules only if source shows them, slate supporting glyphs. Retain meaningful source green/amber/orange states and purple/blue project/avatar artwork; no new gradient button, action, row, metrics, icon or fill.
reviewNotes: Three distinct project artworks, milestone/empty states, health/priority/lead/date states restored and Japanese copy checked. Row2 active-status interior differs from row1 though source shows same glyph; targeted status correction pending. Column/font/artwork fidelity unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
